thread:
Avery Kim: hi everyone, quick setup Q before my first day ":wave:" — I can see the Redwood workspace but not the "Team Templates" folder. need to copy the OKR template and the onboarding goals doc. who owns those and how do I get edit rights?

Nora Patel: welcome Avery! :tada: OKR templates are owned by Product Ops (owner tag at top of page). onboarding goals live under Company / People / New Hires. If you need edit rights quickly, ping docs-ops or open the docs-perms form.

Samir Desai: hey Avery — if you want to duplicate the OKR template, open the page > ••• > Duplicate > Move to "Private" or your team space. owners are product-ops@redwood. I can add you to the page if docs-perms is slow.

Avery Kim: thanks Samir. I filed the form but it says "restricted" on the OKR template. is that normal?

Nora Patel: yep, OKR template is restricted because it includes company-wide OKR scaffolding. Product Ops approves edits. You can still duplicate and fill a private copy once you have view access.

Avery Kim: can someone add me as viewer first so I can duplicate?

docs-ops: Received request: DOCS-2024 from Avery Kim for view/edit on "Company OKR template" and "First-week goals". Routing to Product Ops. ETA: same business day.

Samir Desai: added Avery as viewer on both pages — you should see them now. Reminder: duplicate before editing.

Avery Kim: can confirm I can see and duplicated the OKR template. thanks! one follow-up: where are the team-level templates that include PR review checklist?

Nora Patel: PR checklist is under Engineering / Team Templates -> "PR review checklist (template)". owners = eng-docs. If you need to reuse it, duplicate into your team's repo docs page.

notion-bot: Ticket DOCS-2024 updated: Product Ops approved viewer access for Avery Kim. Owner: Product Ops. Status: viewer granted.

Avery Kim: perfect, everything works. appreciate the quick help :raised_hands:

Samir Desai: ping me if you want a short walkthrough of the template fields tomorrow morning.
